opening.text: The sun is shining over Gan West preschool in Los Angeles.
Morah Sara, the school director, opens the big blue doors with a warm smile.
Inside, the classroom is bright and cheerful — Teacher Elizabeth, Teacher Virginia, and Teacher Jocelyn are busy setting up for a wonderful day!

arrivals-1.text: Cru runs in with his favorite dinosaur backpack.
Right behind him, Mia Alma skips through the door singing a little song.
Mason gives Teacher Elizabeth a big hug!
Aila walks in holding her teddy bear.

arrivals-2.text: Shai zooms past like an airplane — whoooosh!
Chaya waves goodbye to her mommy and runs to the toy kitchen.
Desi and Mia Alexandra arrive together, ready to play!

first-choice.text: Morah Sara claps her hands and says, "Boker tov, yeladim! Good morning, children! What should we do first?"

circle-time.text: Everyone gathers on the colorful rug for circle time!
Teacher Virginia starts playing guitar and they all sing "Shalom Chaverim" together.
Cru claps along, and Mia Alma dances in her spot.
They sing the days of the week in Hebrew — Yom Rishon, Yom Sheni, Yom Shlishi!

free-play.text: Shai and Desi build a tall tower with blocks — it almost reaches the ceiling!
Aila and Mia Alexandra are playing in the toy kitchen, making pretend challah.
Chaya is drawing a rainbow, and Mason reads a book with Teacher Jocelyn.
So many fun things to do!

snack-time.text: Everyone washes their hands and sits at the little tables.
Teacher Elizabeth passes out apple slices and crackers.
Together they say the bracha: "Baruch Atah Hashem... Borei pri ha'etz!"

story-time.text: Teacher Elizabeth opens a big colorful book.
Everyone snuggles close on the reading rug.
Cru makes funny sound effects, and Mia Alma acts out the characters!
Everyone laughs and claps at the happy ending.

dance-party.text: Teacher Virginia puts on music and everyone dances!
Mason and Desi do a silly robot dance.
Mia Alexandra twirls like a ballerina.
Everyone is laughing and moving to the beat!

mystery.text: After snack time, Teacher Virginia notices something — Sparkle the class hamster is not in her cage!
"Where did Sparkle go?" asks Teacher Virginia.

search-playground.text: Everyone runs outside to the playground!
Cru looks under the slide, Mason checks behind the sandbox, and Mia Alma peeks inside the little playhouse.
"I see something fuzzy!" shouts Shai, pointing at the garden.
There's Sparkle, nibbling on a leaf!

search-art.text: The kids tiptoe into the art room.
Mia Alexandra checks under the easels, Desi looks behind the paint jars, and Chaya peeks in the crayon box.
"Look!" whispers Aila, pointing at the paper shelf.
Sparkle is sitting there, cuddled up in a pile of tissue paper!

search-sarah.text: The kids go to Morah Sara's office.
"Morah Sara, Sparkle is missing!" says Desi.
Morah Sara smiles and says, "I think I saw her near the book corner!"
They all rush over, and sure enough — Sparkle is snuggled up inside a big storybook!
She wanted to read a story too!

found-sparkle.text: Teacher Virginia gently picks up Sparkle and puts her back in her cozy cage.
Sparkle wiggles her little nose and everyone giggles.

art-choice.text: Now it's time for an art project!
Teacher Jocelyn sets out the supplies on the big craft table.
"What should we make today?" she asks with a big smile.

art-challah.text: But not the kind you eat — the kind you make with playdough!
Everyone rolls and braids their dough, just like real challah.
Mason makes a tiny one, and Chaya makes a GIANT one.
Teacher Jocelyn helps Desi braid his, and they all paint their challahs golden brown.

art-mezuzah.text: Everyone gets a little wooden mezuzah to decorate!
They use glitter, stickers, and paint to make them sparkly and special.
Mia Alma covers hers in purple glitter, Desi paints stars on his, and Aila adds tiny heart stickers.
"These are for your front doors at home!" says Teacher Jocelyn.

outdoor-play.text: Everyone runs outside into the sunshine.
What do you want to play?

big-slide.text: Shai climbs up to the very top of the big slide.
Wheeeee! He zooms down so fast!
Then Cru goes, then Mia Alma, then everyone takes a turn.
Mason goes down backwards and everyone laughs!
Teacher Jocelyn catches them at the bottom with big hugs.

sandbox-castle.text: Mia Alexandra and Aila start building the biggest sandcastle ever!
Desi brings buckets of sand, and Chaya decorates it with little sticks and leaves.
"It's a castle for Sparkle!" says Aila.
They add a tiny flag on top made from a leaf.

shabbat-prep.text: Everyone helps set the special Shabbat table.
Chaya places the candlesticks, Desi puts out the challah cover, and Mia Alexandra pours the grape juice into little cups.
Teacher Elizabeth lights the candles, and everyone covers their eyes.
"Baruch Atah Hashem... l'hadlik ner shel Shabbat!"
Before we go home, one more thing!

group-photo.text: Everyone squeezes together for a big group photo!
"Say challah!" says Morah Sara, holding up the camera.
"CHALLAH!" everyone shouts with the biggest smiles.
Click! What a perfect picture of the best class ever!

goodbye-song.text: Everyone stands in a circle and holds hands.
Teacher Virginia plays guitar and they all sing the goodbye song together.
Everyone sways back and forth and smiles.

closing.text: What a wonderful day at Gan West!
Now it's time to go home.
The parents arrive one by one, and each kid gets a big hug from the teachers.
Cru waves, Mia Alma blows a kiss, and little Aila gives one last hug to Morah Sara.

end.text: Thank you for spending the day with us.
We can't wait to see you again!
